Propane Exchange Cabinet
[MASTER SWITCH] Enable mod activity

Turn OFF to make the mod completely dormant: no spawning, no recovery, no cabinet visual updates - while the mod stays loaded so your save (especially multiplayer) remains loadable. Use this instead of uninstalling on game 42.20.4+, which cannot cleanly uninstall mods with craftable furniture. Existing cabinets remain as plain containers. A relog may be needed after changing this mid-save.
Fill weight: near-empty tanks
Relative weight for a tank being near-empty (0%%-20%%).
Fill weight: near-full tanks
Relative weight for a tank being near-full (90%%-100%%). Weighted against the near-empty weight. Tanks are never in the 20%%-90%% range.
Welder magazine drop chance (%%)
Chance that a stocked propane cabinet includes the recipe-teaching magazine (Welder Special Edition). 0 = never, 100 = always -- subject to the one-per-save limit below, if enabled.
Limit magazine to one per save

If enabled, the magazine stops dropping after the first copy is found on this save (not per player -- see mod notes for the multiplayer caveat). If disabled, it can drop repeatedly at the chance above.
Max propane tanks per cabinet
Upper limit on how many propane tanks a spawned cabinet is stocked with (actual count is random from 0 to this).
Remove [New - ultra white] cabinets from spawn list
If selected only weathered cabinets will spawn, existing cabinets are not affected.
Spawn chance per gas station (%%)

Chance that a propane exchange cabinet spawns at each eligible location (Fossoil/Gas2Go gas stations, Zippee's convenience stores). Rolled ONCE per station per save - a station that rolls empty stays empty on that save. 0 = never, 100 = always.
